summary: A broad set of WebRender changes improves how Firefox draws and positions text, borders, images, shadows, and clipped content, helping reduce visual glitches such as uneven edges and gaps. The work also makes rendering more robust around large windows, changing content, and complex effects, while reorganizing the GPU backend so rendering can use different graphics devices more consistently. New WebRender debugger tools make it easier to inspect scenes and edit shaders while diagnosing rendering problems.
